purpose: Assess all drug overlap and donor-aware comparison feasibility before inspecting additional cardiac drug effects
identity_rule: PubChem name-derived full InChIKey or RDKit canonical-tautomer full-key agreement with frozen LINCS structure; connectivity-only excluded; actual vial identity not verified
dose_rule: Different numeric concentrations within one drug state make entire drug ineligible until independently resolved; case-only unit capitalization normalized
duplicate_rule: Preserve all perturbation IDs; if multiple full-identity equivalent IDs remain, use median of their frozen LINCS scores for chemical-level descriptive comparison
metadata_rule: Exact GEO title cell line and characteristics treatment condition/investigative unit/sample id/well must reproduce count-design keys; unmatched metadata excluded
candidate_scope: All structure-supported compounds shared with original 482-entry multicell screen, regardless of rank or score sign
known_results: Original LINCS ranking and VEM cardiac result already known; other cardiac effects not inspected
